title: Social Sector Spending (2014‑2019)

caption: Bar chart of education spending as % of GDP (2014‑2019)
altText: The diagram is a vertical bar chart with a white background. The title 'Social Sector Spending (2014‑2019)' appears at the top. The x‑axis runs from 2014 to 2019, each year labeled beneath a steel‑blue bar. The y‑axis is labeled 'Percentage of GDP (%)' and marked from 0% to 4% in 1% increments. Bars show percentages: 2014 – 2.8%, 2015 – 2.9%, 2016 – 3.0%, 2017 – 3.0%, 2018 – 3.0%, 2019 – 3.1%. The chart emphasizes the stagnation, with only a slight increase between 2014 and 2019.
